support_claim: Unresolved-preservation evidence preserves ambiguity about whether crm:OAK-77's pre-rebrand CRM label denotes the same registered counterparty as billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and no proposition directly links OAK-77 to HRB 88421 or the billing legal name.

propositions.proposition: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH, and Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
propositions.relevance: Establishes that the legal names Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH denote the same registered counterparty (same HRB 88421), which is relevant if either candidate referent maps to that entity.

propositions.proposition: CRM still shows the old English-facing name after the rebrand.
propositions.relevance: Indicates the CRM system may retain a pre-rebrand display name for an account, preserving ambiguity about whether crm:OAK-77's label matches the current billing legal name without directly linking OAK-77 to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.

propositions.proposition: CRM record OAK-77 lists the account name as Oakfield Logistics (domain oakfield-log.com, country DE, contact M. Weber, status active).
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent crm:OAK-77; no registry number, legal suffix, or billing identifier appears in this row to tie OAK-77 to Oakfield Logistik GmbH or HRB 88421.

propositions.proposition: Company registry row HRB 88421 lists Oakfield Logistik GmbH, Germany, active.
propositions.relevance: Confirms Oakfield Logistik GmbH is an active registered legal entity matching the billing name string, but the row contains no CRM identifier linking it to crm:OAK-77.

propositions.proposition: Billing records use billed_name Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH as the name used on invoices; no CRM account id is present in this observation.
